necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying arrhythmia. Given the history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0), supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), and sick sinus syndrome (I49.5), prolonged cardiac event monitoring via CPT 93271 is clinically indicated to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
